card.text: The largest moon in the solar system, bigger than Mercury.

introduction.text: Ganymede is the only moon known to have its own magnetic field. Bright grooved terrain cuts across older, darker ground.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Detail ranges from 400 m to 20 km per pixel; shadows in the photographs remain.

enhanced.title: Color mosaic
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and violet bands color the monochrome detail; missing color stays gray.

geology.title: Global geologic map
geology.summary: Twenty-three map symbols for interpreted dark and light terrain and crater and basin materials.

oxygen-signature.title: Oxygen-sensitive reflectance ratio
oxygen-signature.summary: A 565/577.3 nm ratio sensitive to oxygen in surface ice, from 2019 VLT data. It is not an oxygen concentration.

ice-fraction.title: SPHERE water-ice mixture
ice-fraction.summary: Modeled water-ice fraction, 2015/2021 SPHERE data. Roughly 100–150 km detail; gray areas lack observations.

sources.label: Oliver King et al. · SPHERE
sources.locator: Native mapped numerical grids; methods paper

dark-material.title: SPHERE darkening component
dark-material.summary: Modeled fraction of unidentified darkening material, 2015/2021 SPHERE data. Roughly 100–150 km detail.
